description: Create all email communications models, enums and relations in Prisma schema
steps: Add enums: EmailCampaignStatus (draft, scheduled, sending, sent, partially_sent, cancelled)
Add enum: EmailDeliveryStatus (pending, sending, sent, delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, failed)
Add enum: WorkflowTriggerType (course_start, course_end, exam_date, class_date, registration_deadline)
Add enum: CourseWorkflowStatus (active, paused, completed)
Add model EmailTemplate with fields: id, name, subject, body (@db.Text), educatorId, createdAt, updatedAt
Add model EmailCampaign with all fields from PRD including stats counters
Add model EmailRecipient with tracking fields and @@unique([campaignId, studentId])
Add model WorkflowTemplate with fields: id, name, description, educatorId, isActive, timestamps
Add model WorkflowStep with trigger config fields and @@index on workflowTemplateId, templateId
Add model CourseWorkflow with @@unique([courseId, workflowTemplateId])
Add model WorkflowExecution with all tracking fields and @@unique([courseWorkflowId, workflowStepId, studentId])
Add relations to Educator: emailTemplates, emailCampaigns, workflowTemplates
Add relations to Student: emailRecipients, workflowExecutions
Add relations to Course: emailCampaigns, courseWorkflows
Add relation to Enrollment: workflowExecutions
Run: pnpm prisma migrate dev --name add_email_communications
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create email template service with CRUD operations
steps: Create src/services/email-template-service.ts
Implement getTemplatesByEducator(educatorId: string) - returns all templates for an educator
Implement getTemplateById(id: string, educatorId: string) - returns single template with ownership check
Implement createTemplate(data: { name, subject, body, educatorId }) - creates new template
Implement updateTemplate(id: string, educatorId: string, data: { name?, subject?, body? }) - updates with ownership check
Implement deleteTemplate(id: string, educatorId: string) - deletes with ownership check, throws if used in workflows
Implement isTemplateInUse(id: string) - checks if template is used in any WorkflowStep
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck

description: Create email campaign service with create and read operations
steps: Create src/services/email-campaign-service.ts
Implement getCampaignsByEducator(educatorId: string, filters?: { courseId?, status? }) - returns campaigns with template info
Implement getCampaignById(id: string, educatorId: string) - returns campaign with template and recipients
Implement createCampaign(data: { name, templateId, educatorId, courseId?, scheduledAt?, timezone }) - creates draft campaign
Implement addRecipientsToCampaign(campaignId: string, recipients: { studentId, email }[]) - bulk inserts EmailRecipient records
Implement updateCampaignStatus(id: string, status: EmailCampaignStatus) - updates campaign status
Implement updateCampaignStats(id: string) - recalculates aggregated stats from recipients
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck
Create src/lib/email/template-variables.ts
Define AVAILABLE_VARIABLES constant with metadata: { key, description, example }
Define TemplateVariables type with all supported variables (studentName, studentFirstName, studentEmail, courseName, courseStartDate, courseEndDate, examDate, educatorName, courseUrl)
Implement renderTemplate(template: string, variables: TemplateVariables) - replaces {{variable}} placeholders
Implement extractVariables(template: string) - returns array of variable names used in template
Implement validateVariables(template: string) - returns { valid: boolean, invalidVars: string[] }
Implement buildVariablesForStudent(student, course, educator, baseUrl) - builds TemplateVariables object from domain models
Add date formatting helper for Spanish locale (e.g., '15 de marzo de 2025')
Verify with pnpm lint
Verify with pnpm typecheck
